text: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。
author: 孔子

text: 纸上得来终觉浅，绝知此事要躬行。
author: 陆游

text: 不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海。
author: 荀子

text: 天行健，君子以自强不息。
author: 《周易》

text: 问渠那得清如许，为有源头活水来。
author: 朱熹

text: 博观而约取，厚积而薄发。
author: 苏轼

text: 业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随。
author: 韩愈

text: 千里之行，始于足下。
author: 老子

text: 吾生也有涯，而知也无涯。
author: 庄子

text: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
author: 屈原

text: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
author: Linus Torvalds

text: Premature optimization is the root of all evil.
author: Donald Knuth

text: What I cannot create, I do not understand.
author: Richard Feynman

text: The purpose of computing is insight, not numbers.
author: Richard Hamming

text: Simplicity is prerequisite for reliability.
author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

text: We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see plenty there that needs to be done.
author: Alan Turing

text: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
author: Thomas Edison

text: The present is theirs; the future, for which I really worked, is mine.
author: Nikola Tesla

text: All science is either physics or stamp collecting.
author: Ernest Rutherford

text: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
author: Marie Curie

text: When in doubt, use brute force.
author: Ken Thompson

text: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
author: Harold Abelson

text: Measure twice, cut once.
author: Proverb

text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
author: Alan Kay
